verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents its own per-call token usage breakdowns and lets you group traces into user sessions, so usage can plausibly be viewed at the session level. Nothing in the evidence shows rolling cost up by user or feature through custom metadata attributes. missing for 10: custom metadata attribute tagging, dollar cost calculation, aggregation of cost/usage by user or feature, filtering or grouping usage by metadata, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata

citations.quote: Gain a detailed breakdown of token usage for your LLM calls, allowing you to identify and optimize the most expensive LLM invocations.
Group related traces into conversations and user sessions
